Done. I've implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — clamps n to the inclusive range [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — formats byte counts with B/KB/MB/GB units to one decimal place
3. **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — converts to lowercase, trims, replaces space runs with dashes, and removes non-alphanumeric characters except dashes

All are exported from their modules.
